C0539.title: Beijing Woman Detained for Repeatedly Swapping Used Clothes in Online Purchase Refund Scam
C0539.summary: A woman in Beijing ordered 121 clothing items online and then fraudulently returned used garments in place of the new ones to obtain over 20,000 yuan in refunds. She was placed under criminal detention on suspicion of fraud.

references.title: Beijing woman caught for multiple malicious refunds, swaps old clothes for returns after online clothing purchases, 121 incidents
